intent_snapshot.goal: Issue #469 (Spec docs/specs/antigravity-tool-hook-and-mcp-correlation.spec.md). Repair the complete Antigravity native tool chain: dispatch mixed tool/lastUserInput payloads to PreToolUse or PostToolUse before PreInvocation, observe invoke_subagent results, admit Immune-Brain lazy call_mcp_tool operations, replace Claude-only tool metadata with Antigravity conversation-scoped correlation, and preserve literal-user entry, workspace, native confirmation, single-use admission, and Claude compatibility. Keep Herdr process supervision unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: Spec AC1 (BR-REQ-1; D1). Done looks like: Antigravity native tools execute without a PreInvocation-shaped protojson response and subagent completion is observable. Seam: tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts describe "Antigravity hook dispatch and observation", exercising the packaged bundle. Positive: PreToolUse with lastUserInput and write_file or call_mcp_tool returns {decision:"allow"}; PostToolUse with invoke_subagent, result, stepIdx, and lastUserInput returns {} and appends the existing event; Stop still wins over PreInvocation. Negative: a pure PreInvocation payload retains injectSteps output and an unrelated lazy ServerName receives ordinary allow without admission. Bound: the canonical matcher includes call_mcp_tool and no tool payload returns injectSteps.

Spec AC2 (BR-DEC-1; D3, D5). Done looks like: one admitted Antigravity batch operation reaches its authorized confirmation path with no Claude metadata and cannot be replayed or consumed by another conversation. Seam: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe "Antigravity privileged MCP correlation". Positive: after a literal-user drive and matching lazy PreToolUse, start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch with antigravity.google/conversation_id, workspace_paths, and progressToken whose numeric suffix equals hook stepIdx succeed once through their existing authority path even though stepIdx differs from JSON-RPC message.id; two sequential calls receive distinct step admissions. Negative: missing/empty or different conversation, missing/malformed or wrong-step progressToken, replay, and workspace mismatch refuse. Bound: an unrelated lazy call creates no admission, and the admitted conversation becomes the runtime Hook session rather than the transport connection ID.

Spec AC3 (BR-REQ-3; D6). Done looks like: every privileged Antigravity tool reaches its existing native-authority path using Host conversation metadata, not claudecode/toolUseId. Seam: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe "Antigravity privileged native gates". Positive: request_authorization, approve_breaking_intent_revision, and stop with valid interactive Antigravity conversation metadata reach elicitation without Claude metadata. Negative: missing conversation identity refuses before elicitation, and decline/cancel performs no protected mutation. Bound: these three operations neither create nor consume start/retire batch admission, and an actual batch start still requires AC2 admission.

Spec AC4 (BR-OUT-1; D4, D7). Done looks like: generated packages are current and Claude/Pi behavior and Herdr supervision remain unchanged. Seam: focused tests in tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts, tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts, and tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts plus both existing build --check commands. Positive: Claude accepts its established exact claudecode/toolUseId correlation and both generated bundles match fresh builds. Negative: Claude still rejects a privileged call without claudecode/toolUseId. Bound: no new cross-adapter import appears, the existing cross-adapter baseline passes, and no Herdr or supervised-session file changes.
